name: Huzzatul Jannat Shethil
degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering, United International University
tagline: I design user-centered, accessible and visually compelling digital experiences for web and mobile.
openTo: Open to UI/UX design roles & collaborations
about: I am a motivated and creative UI/UX designer with a Computer Science & Engineering degree from United International University. I am committed to creating user-centered, accessible and visually compelling digital experiences.

I bring a solid understanding of design principles, a strategic approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in user behaviour and interaction. As a fast learner with a proactive mindset, I keep growing through practical experience and continuous development.
My background in engineering helps me work closely with developers, and my client-facing experience gives me strong empathy for the people I design for.

process.title: Understand
process.text: UX research and client conversations to uncover user needs, pain points and business goals.

process.title: Map
process.text: User flows and information architecture that make every journey clear and simple.

process.title: Wireframe
process.text: Low-fidelity layouts to explore structure and hierarchy quickly before visual detail.

process.title: Design
process.text: High-fidelity, responsive UI built on design systems for visual consistency and accessibility.

process.title: Prototype
process.text: Interactive prototypes in Figma to test interactions and communicate the experience.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: Close collaboration with developers and stakeholders to ship functional, intuitive products.

strengths: Strong user empathy from client interactions
Detail-oriented with a focus on quality

points: Designed user-centered web and mobile interfaces using Figma, focusing on usability and visual consistency.
Created user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI designs.
Applied UX research, interaction design, design systems and responsive design to improve user experiences.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders to deliver functional, intuitive digital products.
Engaged with clients to identify needs, understand pain points and deliver tailored solutions aligned with business goals.
Collaborated with technical teams to translate client requirements into clear, actionable solutions and ensure smooth project delivery.

projects.title: UniVerseHub
projects.subtitle: An integrated platform for Bangladeshi university students
projects.description: UniVerseHub brings together AI-powered academic assistance, mental health resources and productivity tools in one place for Bangladeshi university students. I led the UI/UX design process in Figma and implemented responsive, user-friendly front-end components to deliver a seamless digital experience.
